customMethods.name: stateSelected
linkAssetStates
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("linkAssetStates() called")

	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	assetId = self.view.params.values.assetIdList[0]
	stateSelection = self.view.custom.states.selection
	
	data = system.kanoa.asset.getAssetStates({'assetId': assetId})
	stateCodeList = list(set([row['stateCode'] for row in data if row['stateCode']]))
	stateCodeList.sort()
	stateCodeList = list(stateCodeList)
	assetStates = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToDict(data, 'stateId', None)

	stateIds = []
	stateCodes = []

	stateIdList = stateSelection['stateIds']
	for stateCategoryPath in stateSelection['stateCategoryPaths']:
		stateIdList += [row['stateId'] for row in system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.asset.getStates({'stateCategoryPath': stateCategoryPath + '%', 'enabled': True}))]	
	
	stateIdList = list(set(stateIdList))

	for stateId in stateIdList:
		item = assetStates[stateId] if assetStates.has_key(stateId) else None
		if item is None: 
			stateIds.append(stateId)
			stateCode = max(stateCodeList or [-1]) + 1
			stateCodes.append(stateCode)
			stateCodeList.append(stateCode)

		elif not item['linkEnabled']: system.kanoa.asset.enableAssetStateLink(item['stateAssetLinkId'], True)
		else: system.perspective.print("No need to do anything, already linked and enabled")

	if len(stateIds) == 0: 
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': 'There are no states selected that need linking'})
		return

	self.view.custom.info = {"showBar": True, "text": "Linking assetId %s with stateId %s"%(assetId, stateIds), "type": "INFO"}
	system.perspective.print("linkAssetStates() called with %s %s %s %s"%([assetId], stateIds, userId, stateCodes))
	system.kanoa.asset.linkAssetStates([assetId], stateIds, userId, stateCodes)
	self.view.custom.info = {"showBar": False, "text": "", "type": "INFO"}
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.assetStates.data")
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Asset links have been updated'})

	return

customMethods.name: unlinkAssetStates
customMethods.script:
#If there are downtime records associated with the link, then we will disable them
	#If there are no records, then we can delete the link

	disabled = False
	import time
	states = self.view.custom.assetStates.selectedData
	for row in states:
		retVal, msg = system.kanoa.asset.unlinkAssetState(row['stateAssetLinkId'])
		if msg == 'Disabled':
			disabled = True
			system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': '%s state has been disabled as there are historical entries asssociated with this state.'%row['stateName']})
			time.sleep(0.5)

	if not disabled: system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': '%s been unlinked'%('States have' if len(states) > 1 else 'State has')})

	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.assetStates.data")
	
	return

	droppedItem = payload['inputPayload']['droppedItem']
